choices.choice_text: Who are you? Where am I?

nodes.text: YUNA... Wake up, lost soul. Truck-kun has delivered you to AETHERIA. I am AQUA, goddess of rebirth. The Demon Lord VAELEN has shattered the Shadow Relic into 3 fragments. Will you sign the Otherworld Contract?

choices.choice_text: Tell me about the Minotaur King.

nodes.text: GROM: So Aqua dragged another one through the veil, eh? Listen, kid — skeletons pour from the FORGOTTEN CATACOMBS every night. The Minotaur King guards the second Relic Fragment. Prove yourself: bring me 5 Bone Charms.

choices.choice_text: Why did you shatter the Relic?

nodes.text: VAELEN: Little summoned one... I was the FIRST summoned hero, a century ago. Aqua abandons every hero when the people stop worshipping. I shattered the Relic so no one else would be chained. Join me — or be unmade.
